provenance.scope: Conditional evidence request only. No model fitting, counterfactual calculation or kinetics-sufficiency verdict.

missing_followup.needed_for: Only if a predictive what-if is required rather than a descriptive record review

missing_followup.result_available_time: unknown; no approved model/version release supplied
missing_followup.next_step: Choose an appropriate model and test its assumptions, parameters, independent validation, balances and domain; kinetics alone is not automatic sufficiency or an operating recommendation.
